text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The Queen Elizabeth II Cup is a 2,200m 
medium-distance race, just like the Yushun 
Himba (Oaks).

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
“That was such a tough, painful race... 
It's scary just looking back on it, 
but...”

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If Trainer believes that I can do it... 
then I want to live up to those feelings!
